items.prompt: What specific risk does Renee's added move — naming the boundary of what she can speak to — protect against with Kai?

Kai forgetting the conversation entirely

items.explanation: Naming the boundary is specifically aimed at preventing triangulation — Kai treating Renee's honest guess as if it were the actual, authoritative answer from Kai's own manager.

items.learnMore:
Naming the boundary explicitly

Skip-level mentoring adds one move beyond the core four: explicitly stating what you can and can't actually speak to, so an outside perspective doesn't get mistaken for an authoritative one.
